PRICING SELECTION allows a shorthand method of setting the pricing functions. If a number from one to nine is entered into the PRICING SELECTION function, a corresponding standard setting (shown in bold type above) will be entered into the game. The rest of the pricing functions are automatically set for that standard.

THE PRICE OF ONE GAME (number of coins per game) is equal to the number of SLOT UNITS for any one slot divided by the number of UNITS PER CREDIT. If the number of LEFT SLOT UNITS (or RIGHT SLOT UNITS) equals X and the number of UNITS PER CREDIT equals Y, then the price of one game is XV.
UNITS REQUIRED FOR BONUS CREDIT is the number of games that must be purchased before a free game is awarded.

MINIMUM UNITS FOR ANY CREDIT is the least number of . coins allowed per game or games: Or put another way, the MINIMUM UNITS FOR ANY CREDIT determines the smatiest number of whole games that may be paid for at one time.
